The primary goal of the paper is the glycopeptide profiling (mod_glyco).

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This study is a method development and validation paper focused on establishing an analytical workflow for immunoglobulin glycosylation profiling. While the authors optimized sample preparation parameters (bead volume, incubation time, digestion time) and applied the method to 19 human plasma samples, there is no primary biological perturbation or differential case-vs-control comparison axis defining the proteomics experiment. The 'comparisons' mentioned are technical optimizations of the assay itself. Therefore, it is classified as un-classified.
